findings: Critical integration gap: The knowledge module (anvil/knowledge.py) provides packet_knowledge_section() to inject Design knowledge sections into packets (spec S3), but this function is never called by the runner or design module. The station prompts reference 'The Design knowledge section in your packet (when present)' (reviewer-design PROMPT.md line 21), confirming dynamic packet injection is required, yet anvil/design.py:packet_design_section() does not import or call the knowledge module, and anvil/runner.py:packet_step() line 439 only calls packet_design_section() without knowledge integration. The knowledge data layer and rendering logic exist but are not wired into the packet building pipeline.

Incomplete runtime integration: Spec scenarios S3, S7 and S8 require knowledge pack loading and slice computation at run start with pack recording in run reports, but anvil/runner.py shows no imports from anvil.knowledge (line 1-15), no calls to load_knowledge_pack() or compute_knowledge_slice(), and no integration of knowledge_pack field from work orders. The runner must load packs at intake (S9), compute slices once per run (S2), and inject them into design station packets (S3), but none of this runtime wiring exists.

Missing routing policy integration: Spec S10 requires the guide designation to reference the design model from 'the recorded routing policy' (spec line 36), and docs/UX-MODULE.md states the model is 'from the factory's routing policy (currently openai/gpt-6-astra)' (line 111), yet the station.json files hardcode design_model: 'openai/gpt-6-astra' instead of reading it from anvil/routing.py's policy. The implementation should call load_routing_policy() or read from a central config, not duplicate the model string across three station catalogs.

Architectural fit with Decision 0001 composable stations: The knowledge module correctly extends the factory as a reusable component (knowledge.py in anvil/ package, data in design-knowledge/ at factory root), and station catalog updates are minimal additions to existing stations. Station IDs remain unique and the module does not redefine stations. This aligns with the composable stations decision.
